visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black hair and glasses, wearing a grey t-shirt, sits on a white wooden floor. He is surrounded by over a dozen thick stacks of books, each bound with pink and red ribbons. The background shows a white decorative Christmas tree and cream-colored curtains. (2) Close-up shows various book spines, mostly in Chinese. The scene shifts to a large, wooden wall-to-wall bookshelf filled with hundreds of books and small ornaments. A brown striped beanbag chair sits in the foreground. (3) In a kitchen with a wooden table, hands are seen peeling pinkish shallot skins into stainless steel bowls. A man in glasses and a young girl with dark hair and glasses are seated at the table, working on the shallots. (4) A close-up of a woman's eyes reveals her squinting and scrunching her face. Light blue cartoon tear drop overlays appear on either side of her nose. (5) A young girl wearing a white hoodie, yellow shorts, knee pads, and a grey helmet rides a yellow and white YouBike on a paved trail. Green trees and foliage line the path. (6) A woman wearing a wide-brimmed hat and a purple jacket holds a camera in a selfie position while riding. She smiles at the camera. In the background, the girl and man are riding their bikes on a road next to grassy fields. (7) The girl rides her bike along a wooden bridge structure through a forest. Later, she is seen riding along a coastal path with the ocean visible in the distance. She stops at one point, using her feet to scoot the bike on an incline.
